metadata.title: Bloom Energy Joins the S&P 500 as The Trade Desk Leaves

content.text:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Bloom Energy Corp. (NYSE:BE) rose 5.63% premarket after S&P Dow Jones Indices said it will join the S&P 500 before the open on September 21, part of the quarterly rebalance. Illumina Inc. (NASDAQ:ILMN) and Everpure (NYSE:P) join alongside it. Illumina rose 1.04% and Everpure 2.70%.
The Trade Desk Inc. (NASDAQ:TTD), Molson Coors Beverage Co. (NYSE:TAP) and Builders FirstSource Inc. (NYSE:BLDR) all leave the S&P 500, and none of them lands in the MidCap 400. All three go straight to the SmallCap 600.
Dell Technologies Inc. (NYSE:DELL), Palo Alto Networks Inc. (NASDAQ:PANW), Arista Networks Inc. (NYSE:ANET) and Sandisk Corp. (NASDAQ:SNDK) all join the S&P 100, and every one is classified Information Technology. Out go Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ:HONA), NIKE Inc. (NYSE:NKE), Simon Property Group Inc. (NYSE:SPG) and Colgate-Palmolive Co. (NYSE:CL), spanning industrials, consumer discretionary, real estate and consumer staples.
